title: Reiwa no Dara-san

thread.title: Dara-san of Reiwa • Reiwa no Dara-san - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: The community strongly enjoyed the episode’s blend of horror, comedy, and everyday character humor.
Many viewers found the mecha parody and its dedicated ending sequence exceptionally fun and well executed.
Kaoru’s chaotic personality and reactions were repeatedly praised as a major source of comedy.
Several commenters considered the series one of the season’s best or an underappreciated standout.
The darker backstory was viewed as compelling and effective, though some reactions found its brutality disturbing.
Some viewers were disappointed that an important supernatural confrontation was not shown directly.
A few commenters felt Dara-san had too limited a role in the episode’s present-day material.

notes: The title and body explicitly identify Reiwa no Dara-san episode 6. Reddit’s rendered page exposed the discussion and comments but not reliable post score metadata, so score is reported as 0. Comments were paraphrased and plot details were omitted from the sentiment summary.
